## Description

Provide a summary of the changes proposed in this Pull Request and their motivation.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] `perf`: Performance enhancement (e.g. GPU pipeline optimization, frame pacing)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructure without behavioral alterations
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build system, or dependency updates
